h1: Custom Utilities Lighters for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom utilities lighters in bulk for your workforce. Perfect for safety teams and field crews. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Utilities lighters are essential tools for workers in gas, electric, and water services who need reliable ignition in the field. Unlike standard promotional lighters, these are designed for durability and safety, featuring wind-resistant flames and ergonomic grips. Customize them with your company logo or safety messaging to reinforce brand presence on every job site. Ideal for safety managers equipping crews or marketing directors distributing at industry events.
heroAltText: Custom utilities lighters with company logo printed on durable, wind-resistant body for field use
